keyFindings.statement: Gate 5 fires on the first write of a session only; read-only turns never fire it.
The router matches on the action about to be taken, never the prompt topic.
Corpus is 13 rule files with 255 trigger_phrases total; phrases name dispositions, not tool actions.
A static second load path already exists where Gate 5 cannot reach replies (AGENTS.md:261).
The trigger index deliberately excludes .skilled/repo-rules; the documented reason is that indexing them would surface a rule as a context candidate.
022's admission bar refuses prompt-time injections that restate a disposition; only a gate-enforced prohibition earns a slot.
022's measurement lesson: event frequency must be read from the log, never reasoned about.
The advisor brief fires every user prompt; the constant directive is deduped via directive-lifecycle.ts.
Federation: canonical corpus .skilled/repo-rules (13 files); Public/repo-rules is a symlink layer; Obsidian holds 12 of 13 symlinked; answer-the-actual-request.md never propagated.
010's constraint: content that must bind while reading cannot live in a rule file; the rule set should not grow.
Brief emission: three emit sites (render.ts:441,449,486); route capped at 80 tokens; directives appended after cap.
Measured sizes: route 42B, label 12B, hygiene 207B, full brief ~261B; pointer draft 162B (~40 tokens).
Dedup: full on first/boundaries/content-change/transcript-shrink; route-only on proven repeats; fail-safe full otherwise.
No repo-relevance signal in the renderer; handler carries workspaceRoot; unconditional emission fires in repos without REPO RULES.md.
Candidate (a) is a prompt-time reminder surface, not action-keyed; value is timing and AGENTS.md-absent runtimes.
Blast radius: render.ts three emit sites + OpenCode plugin mirror + exact-string tests.
Pointer text must name the repo-root router, never the corpus path.
Candidate (a) fails 022's bar: restates a Gate-5 disposition, names no gate-enforced prohibition; hygiene asymmetry.
Candidate (b) is one line at corpus.mjs:30; generator indexes 13 docs / 255 phrases; 7 single-token phrases never rank.

Empirical: today rule-vocab prompts return 0 results exit 1; simulated hits are 0.880 query-containment ('add a retry'->root-cause, 'force push'->blast-radius, 'unsolicited warning'->answer-the-actual-request).
Index: 3,738,528 bytes / 33,688 phrases / 13,172 paths; growth +13 paths, +255 phrases, est. +10-25KB; parse dominates per-lookup.
Silence: scoring-only drops score-0 rows and exits 1; 2 of 5 realistic prompts zero-hit.
Candidate (b) matches prompt topic, never action; trigger-table action phrases absent from rule trigger_phrases; complementary to Gate 5.
Portability: canonical .skilled path wins dedupe; sibling reads shared index via .skilled symlink; root 'repo-rules' breaks sibling; one static root cannot serve both layouts.
Documented decision-against at retrieval-conventions.md:284 states the structural reason; admission must overturn it explicitly.
Maintenance: staleness is phrase-set only; publication fail-closed corpus-wide; corpus checker internal-only.
Rule phrase 'silent reinterpretation' is already an index key owned by another document; index tolerates multi-owner phrases; corpus collision hygiene is index-blind.
Candidate (c) shape: advisory naming rule file(s) for the matched action; spec-gate precedent proves delivery machinery; tool-call→row mapping does not exist today.
Candidate (c) silence: no row match + once-per-session dedup with re-arm; cost: process spawn per matched event + ~100-200B advisory; frequency log-measured post-build.
Candidate (c) matches on action — the router's own key; only candidate addressing later-in-session actions; shared core + per-runtime wiring.
Candidate (d): no measured miss exists; flip test = measured miss with cost; status quo covers first-write and replies.
Cross-candidate: only (c) action-keyed; (a) fails 022 bar; (b) reverses documented decision, topic-keyed; (d) no measured miss/win; (c) strongest precedent, open risk classifier quality.
No tool-call-to-trigger-row mapping module exists today; spec-gate classifies spec-folder intent, not rule rows.
All candidates respect 010's no-rule-growth constraint; emitted text must never embed the corpus path.
